reports.desc: Mail sent to our office indicating our Domain name was expiring and a 5 year renewal was due and needed. Person paying did not know or realize they did not hold our domain. Attempts to immediately cancel the charge were made, but person's via the "support" email were rude and ignored requests for cancelation and refund.

Scammer sent an invoice appearing to be a renewal for the domain name. They were and are not the domain holders and the domain was not expired or expiring as they indicated.
Office person paid "bill" not realizing they were not the domain holder and no renewal was needed
Tried keeping in touch by email they would say on the way

company advertised extra large boxes from returned pallets. special if you buy 2. See product description.jpg.  Then they add shipping and "tip."  What I received was a phone charging cable and a base in a padded envelope. Also shown in attachment. They refuse to provide refund or acknowledge the scam, deceitfulness, and completely inappropriate marketing scheme to dupe people out of money.

The Scammer said we owed $498.85 for an Annual Fax Service which includes fax number routing, web portal access, searchable transmission records, encrypted transmission, service availability monitoring, standard support, and data export functionality.

Harassing robocalls about loan pre approvals multiple times daily for weeks despite being on the national do not call registry and opting out 5 times. When I use the prompts to get to a representative I get different information each time with slightly different variations of the company name (always some variation of Cavalry) and headquartered location (always east coast, mostly NY or NJ). When I ask about loan process and how to apply I’ve been hung up on.

Once I made the payment they went radio silent. When I emailed to get status they couldn't provide a status after waiting for over 2 weeks I decided to cancel they advised that they will refund me but keep 35.00 from my refund due to consultation however there was no consultation and when I asked who did the consultation? When did it took place? What were the results of the consultation they couldn't answer my questions. I told them to cancel and refund me my money after numerous of follow ups they said refund take 3-5 days which already been 3-5 days and no refund is showing in my statement.  They keep 35.00 out of every cancelation under consultation that does not exist.

I was approached by a young man on the street with a leather booklet. He claimed to be raising money for his sister's funeral, and I agreed to donate $20. I was then surrounded by three young men, one of whom took my phone and the other who took my credit card. They attempted multiple charges on my credit card.

I was approached by a young man on the street who claimed to be gathering donations for his sisters funeral following her suicide. He had a leather binder with pictures of the young woman as well as a sheet with several other "donors" and their information. I agreed to donate $20, at which point the man called over 2 other men and they took my card and cellphone while tapping to make charges on another phone.
